summary: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously.
takeaways: Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously.
To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals.
DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.
